text: This report addresses an appeal respecting a first party Signage Master Plan ("SMP") proposal for two electronic wall signs displaying electronic static copy (the "Proposed Signs"). The Proposed Signs are to be located at the first storey, within the return walls of the recessed entranceway along the south elevation of the two-storey theatre and restaurant building located at the property municipally known as 1006 Bloor Street West (the "Premises"), which is a Heritage-designated building. The purpose of the Proposed Signs is to advertise, promote and direct attention to events and functions at the "Paradise Theatre". This SMP is for only two signs, but is being considered as an SMP instead of a Sign Variance application because there is an existing SMP in effect at this property, which includes one illuminated projecting sign and three illuminated overhanging structure signs (see…

The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Granted the requested variances to sections 694-21D, 694-14E, 694-20I, 694-20A(2) and 694-20M required for Signage Master Plan consisting of the Proposed Signs concerning the portion of the premises municipally known as 1006 Bloor Street West, as described in Attachment 1 of the report (November 19, 2018) from the Manager, Sign By-law Unit, Toronto Building.
